1.explanation:
• sprite-selector-item (component + container): Renders the show/hide (eye) toggle buttons. It currently toggles icon color but needs to swap background color on selection.  
• direction-picker (component + container): Renders the rotation‐style icons. It also highlights the active icon by fill color only and must be updated to apply a background color instead.  
• icon-button: The shared button component that both controls use. It applies fill/gray to the icon based on an active prop; this file should be extended to accept and render a background color for the selected state and reset to white when unselected.
1.bug_scenario: On certain setting switches (the show/hide visibility toggle and the rotation‐style selector), the UI currently indicates the active choice by coloring in the icon and leaves the inactive icons gray. In grayscale (or for many colorblind users), the filled vs. unfilled icons are indistinguishable, so it’s impossible to tell which option is selected. The proposed fix is to add a distinct background on the selected button (e.g. blue) and use a white background on unselected buttons, rather than relying solely on icon color.

2.explanation:
• sprite-info.jsx contains the rotation-style icons and the show/hide eye toggle in the sprite details pane. It’s where we render the IconButtons and apply the selected/​unselected classes.  
• sprite-selector-item.jsx renders the eye-toggle button in the sprite list (target pane). It likewise uses IconButton for visibility state.  
• icon-button.jsx is the core component that defines how an icon button renders its background when active/hovered. We need to augment this so it can display a colored background for “selected.”  
• button.jsx establishes general button styling (including default background, padding, borders). Updating it (or its CSS) ensures consistency between text-label buttons and icon buttons when showing selection.  
• default/index.js, high-contrast/index.js, and dark/index.js define theme colors (brandAccent, bgHighlight, etc.). We must add or adjust theme variables (e.g. a stronger background for selected icons) so the new selected/background colors work in all themes.
2.bug_scenario: The current show/hide and rotation-style toggles rely on colored-in icons for the “on” state and gray icons for “off.” In a grayscale rendering (or for colorblind users) the two states look virtually identical. The intended fix is to give the selected button a colored background (e.g. blue) and the unselected buttons a white background so that state is unmistakable even without color cues.
